turns.text: Big news — we finally adopted a dog this weekend! A golden retriever. We named him Biscuit.
Congratulations on adopting Biscuit! Golden retrievers are wonderful family dogs. How is he settling in so far?
He's settling in great, though he chewed through one of my running shoes already.
That's very puppy of him. A few sturdy chew toys and consistent redirection usually saves the rest of your shoe rack.
Work update: I handed in my notice at Acme Corp. I'm joining Borealis Labs as a data engineer, starting in July.
Congratulations on the move to Borealis Labs! A July start gives you a bit of breathing room after Acme. What drew you to the role?
Mostly the team — and they let me keep working remotely. Also Biscuit had his first vet visit; all healthy, 9.2 kg.
A healthy 9.2 kg at his age sounds right on track, and remote work plus a new puppy is a great combination.
Small change of plan — Borealis pushed my start date to August because of a hiring freeze wrapping up.
Thanks for the update — so the Borealis Labs start moves from July to August. An extra month with Biscuit before the new role isn't the worst outcome.
True. I'll use the time to finish the trail-running plan I abandoned in spring.
A month of consistent base miles will set you up well — and Biscuit will happily volunteer as a training partner.
